subject.title: iOS: Settings → Gateway buries QR pairing below plumbing

question: Should the iOS Gateway screen adopt pairing-first navigation and section ordering as the canonical settings hierarchy?
rationale: The pairing implementation already exists; the unresolved choice is the intended prominence and ordering of user-facing settings, which requires iOS product ownership rather than an automated correctness decision.

options.title: Adopt Pairing-First Layout
options.body: Make QR pairing immediately available, group all add-gateway methods near the top, and move manual and advanced plumbing to the end.

options.title: Add Scan Shortcut Only
options.body: Add the navigation-bar QR action while retaining the current section order to minimize layout churn.

options.title: Keep Current Hierarchy
options.body: Retain the existing screen and address discoverability through labels or documentation only.

recommendation.title: Adopt Pairing-First Layout
recommendation.body: Make QR pairing immediately available, group all add-gateway methods near the top, and move manual and advanced plumbing to the end.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue supplies the proposed product hierarchy and is explicitly routed for maintainer handling.
